translation: Nithande ⟨את⟩ umrhwebi wasezweni langaphandle, kuba naba ngabahlali basezweni langaphakade kuni, kwaye naba ngabahlatywa njengabahlanzi kwaMitsrayim: nithande ⟨את⟩ umrhwebi, kuba naba ngabahlali bexesha elide kuni, naba ngamatshabi kwisiqithi somzantsi eMitsrayim: nithande ngoko ⟨את⟩ umrhwebi wasezweni elungekho elakuni, kuba nabe ningabahlali basezweni lakwaMitsrayim.
